quality.candidate_definition: Structured dispatch rows with a recognized apparatus identifier and broad emergency type.

method.label: Source corpus
method.text: Server-side structured rows from the live OHPAH Research dispatch corpus. The public response contains aggregates only.

method.label: Candidate rule
method.text: A row counts only when it contains both a recognized apparatus identifier and a broad fire, medical, or motor-vehicle type.

method.label: Privacy boundary
method.text: The query never selects transcript, address, row identifier, audio, or person-level fields; only aggregate counts leave the worker.

method.label: Publish check
method.text: The endpoint and website publisher fail closed when the source is unavailable, no candidates are found, required fields are missing, or totals do not reconcile.

limitations: Florida radio systems represented in the OHPAH Research corpus only.
Transcript-derived alert candidates are not verified CAD incidents or confirmed unit responses.
Repeated transmissions with the same talkgroup, unit, and broad type are grouped within a ten-minute window.
No transcript, address, source-row link, row identifier, or person-level record is published.
